channel.title: Guidance for Longevity, Mobility and Endurance
channel.description: Practical articles on longevity, mobility and endurance from Sanjeev Kumar, a Level 3 personal trainer in South Surrey.

item.title: Beyond the Scale: Understanding Body Composition Changes
item.description: Weight alone does not tell the whole story. Learn what body composition is, why the scale can stall while you improve, and simple ways to track real progress.

item.title: Creatine Basics: What It Is and Who Might Consider It
item.description: Curious about creatine? Learn what it does, what the research says, who might consider it, and what to check with your doctor first.

item.title: Eating for Performance: What to Have Before, During and After Training
item.description: Fuel your training with simple food timing. See what to eat before, during and after a workout, how much to drink, and a sample day for active people.

item.title: Eating Vegan and Training Well: Protein and Nutrients
item.description: Training on a vegan diet? See how to get enough protein, iron, calcium and B12, and build simple plant-based meals that support your workouts.

item.title: Everyday Vitamins and Supplements: Do You Actually Need Them?
item.description: Not sure if you need vitamin D, B12, iron or a multivitamin? Learn when food is enough, who may benefit from supplements and how to choose safely in Canada.

item.title: Exercise With Arthritis, Osteoporosis or Muscle Loss: Where to Start
item.description: Living with arthritis, osteoporosis or age-related muscle loss? Learn why strength and balance work matter, how to start gently and when to ask your doctor.

item.title: Gluten-Free and Lactose-Free Eating for Active People
item.description: Avoiding gluten or lactose and still training hard? See how to cover protein, carbs, calcium and fibre, read labels and build easy meals.

item.title: Recovery Supplements: What Helps and What Is Mostly Hype
item.description: Wondering which supplements help recovery? See why sleep, food and rest come first, what the evidence says about common products, and how to choose safely.

item.title: Training Alongside Testosterone Therapy: What Exercise Can Do
item.description: On testosterone therapy and wondering how to train? Learn what strength training, food and sleep add, and why every medical decision stays with your doctor.

item.title: Training While on Ozempic: Protect Your Muscle
item.description: Using Ozempic or a similar medication? Learn why strength training and protein matter, and how to keep your muscle, energy and routine on track.

item.title: A Vegetarian Plate Built for Strength
item.description: How to get enough protein, iron and other key nutrients on a vegetarian diet while you train, with simple meal ideas and common pitfalls.

item.title: Fat Loss Without the Crash: Habits That Last
item.description: Skip the crash diets. Learn the simple habits behind sustainable fat loss: protein, strength training, steps, sleep and a realistic pace.

item.title: Staying Active During Pregnancy: A Plain-Language Guide
item.description: What current guidelines say about exercise during pregnancy, simple ways to stay active, warning signs to stop, and how to ease back after birth.

item.title: Starting From Zero: Your First Month of Training
item.description: New to exercise? A calm, week-by-week plan for your first month of training, with tips on soreness, habits and how to know it is working.

item.title: Mobility for Desk Workers: A 10-Minute Routine
item.description: Stiff hips, tight shoulders and a sore neck from desk work? Try these simple movement breaks and a 10-minute mobility routine.

item.title: Strength Training After 50: Where to Start
item.description: A plain-language guide to starting strength training after 50: the basic movements, a simple weekly plan, and how to progress safely.
